term: essential causal dependence: local transmission versus finite grounding
resolution: LocalTransmission constrains neighboring activities by equality; PowerTransmissionRule generalizes to immediate causes and an explicit cut-edge model, but admits more than one global fixed point on the successor chain. FinitelyGroundedPower, in contrast, is inductively generated by independent source power and finite actual transmission paths. Neither is automatically identical to Aquinas' per se efficient causal link. Showing that an actual per se chain requires the inductive rather than a greatest/coinductive or globally constrained solution remains an open, independently sourced metaphysical obligation.
